content.description:
Mystery Token is on the Cardano blockchain.

Born on January 27, 2022 on a dark and stormy winter eve, where snow flurries buried sleeping rabbits inside their burrows and scared the little children with shuddering gates flapping in the dark of night.

The token has a max supply of 100 million tokens, with a plan to distribute 80% to persons around the globe in mysterious ways. The utility of the token was imagined as question marks floating in a sea of ellipses, while the technology behind the token was carefully designed to be highly non-existent.

The token’s purpose is perhaps the greatest mystery of all and will keep you guessing long into the night. You can envision the roadmap of the Mystery Token as a winding road stretching off into a dark abyss, or think of it like birds fluttering over the horizon out of view; where did the road lead, where did the birds go? These are burning enigmas that fuel the Mystery Token.

Created by a man called Mr. E, an apparent misanthropic shut-in who avoids the light; because, he thinks perhaps he might be a vampire (?).

The philosophy of Mystery Token is simple:

Keep it mysterious, always.
